reviews.rationale: Reviewed explicit mid mercenary alternative in the guide table. Native identity and valid upgrades required; ethereal and minimum rolls remain usable. Guardian raises resistance caps but supplies no actual resistance or mercenary Paladin/block benefits. Gladiator flat DR/MDR, CBF and recovery require level85; flat reduction is not percent reduction. Flayed supplies physical-hit leech and regeneration; repair is not a mercenary need. Face supplies strength/resistance, while flee may scatter packs and is not a universal advantage. Numeric market price and finished survival setup are separate.
advisory_conditions: Verify mercenary level, strength and dexterity requirements. Ethereal durability is safe on mercenaries; no automatic price premium is inferred.

reviews.rationale: Reviewed explicit player defensive ring/belt alternative. Native minimum rolls and valid upgrades suffice; repairable nonethereal and zero legal sockets are required. Dwarf has percentage fire absorb and flat MDR; Verdungo physical DR and player vitality; String physical DR and flat MDR, with leech only for reviewed physical-attack builds; Thundergod flat lightning absorb and raised cap. Actual resistance and full breakpoints remain separate. Amazon skill bonuses apply only to the named Lightning Fury/Strike use, and Dwarf Gold Find priority is confined to the Gold Find guide. No passive charged summon, complete immunity, market price or perfect-roll requirement is inferred.
advisory_conditions: The raised lightning cap needs actual lightning resistance. Lightning absorb is a flat amount.

reviews.rationale: Explicit Enchant weapon alternative. Gear Options names explosive arrows as a useful weapon property, and native Raven Claw supplies that property. Enchant must be active; physical weapon ED is not the fire damage priority. Native and upgraded bows remain usable; the native Long Bow has level requirement15, upgrades increase requirements. This is not the Standard Demon Machine/Pierce setup and does not imply its99% pierce. No price inferred.
advisory_conditions: Requires an active Enchant buff; explosive arrows do not provide Enchant by themselves.

reviews.rationale: Cached Gear Options explicitly says White base with +2-3 Poison Nova is suitable. Accept+2; do not require perfect+3 from the planner-only Budget example. White does not grant Poison Nova, so the observed bonus establishes that base staffmod. Legal two-socket wand capacity and completed recipe required. Ethereal is usable for spell casting, not sustainable melee. Prioritize Poison and Bone skills, Poison Nova, FCR, mana, MDR and defensive Bone Armor; native Bone Spear/Skeleton Mastery do not imply Poison Nova priorities. Empty Bone Wand advice shares the same source. No market price or full loadout breakpoint inferred.

reviews.rationale: Reviewed explicit player caster/progression alternative. Magefist FCR and mana regen benefit casting; fire skill priority belongs to reviewed fire builds, never its flat attack fire damage. Peasant Crown offers skills, movement, attributes and regeneration; Tarnhelm skills/MF. Suicide Branch caster-only use permits ethereal spell casting but not sustainable melee. Silkweave mana after kill requires wearer kill credit, not leech or minion kills. Goldskin is the explicit Gold Find Barbarian resistance/gold alternative. Native minimum rolls and valid upgrades suffice; zero sockets on gloves/boots, nonethereal armor. No complete loadout breakpoint or numerical price inferred.
advisory_conditions: Faster Cast Rate affects spells and teleport, not attacks or trap laying. Added fire attack damage does not increase spell damage.

Ethereal weapons can spend remaining charges but cannot recharge. Teleport availability does not establish a full caster setup; Lower Resist does not guarantee an immunity break; Life Tap needs application and eligible attacks. Decorated Gaean/Venomous/Arch-Devil combinations are intentionally separate reviews. No item price inferred.

Duress requires three filled sockets; Crushing Blow/Open Wounds/off-weapon ED require eligible attacks, and cold damage can destroy corpses needed by Find Item or corpse skills. Rockstopper supplies percent DR, recovery and fire/lightning/cold resistance; its Vitality is not mercenary life. All three need life leech elsewhere. Native minimum rolls and either ethereal state remain useful; no price or complete survival setup is inferred.
advisory_conditions: Verify mercenary level, strength and dexterity requirements. Ethereal durability is safe on mercenaries; no automatic price premium is inferred.
Crushing Blow, Open Wounds and off-weapon damage need eligible attacks, not mercenary spells. Duress supplies no life leech.
Cold damage can shatter corpses; consider Find Item or corpse-dependent skills before choosing Duress.

advisory_conditions: The cited planner uses an upgraded Diamond Bow, Protector's Stone and another jewel. Meet upgraded requirements; do not assume the unspecified jewel has particular rolls.

Amplify Damage is a 2% on-striking level 5 proc, not permanent uptime; competing curses can replace it. Deadly Strike scales with character level and does not independently stack with Critical Strike for quadruple damage.
The normal-attack Magic Arrow property does not turn Strafe into Magic Arrow. Weapon ED and physical pierce concern physical bow damage; Find and resistance utility remain separate.
Only one Colossal Jewel can be equipped per character; verify other equipped recipients before using this bow. This narrow planner alternative does not endorse every Magic Find loadout.

Native Topaz armor effect is 24 MF each, not weapon lightning damage or shield resistance. All socketed gems must be distinct linked Perfect Topazes. advisory_conditions: Mask with 3 Perfect Topazes provides 72% Magic Find. This is a low-investment gear alternative; keep needed casting speed and survival elsewhere. Filled gems prevent runeword creation until removed.

Topazes grant Magic Find in armor/helms, lightning resistance in shields and added lightning damage in weapons. Those other recipients do not satisfy this armor setup. Ethereal armor cannot be repaired for sustained player use.

reviews.rationale: 2026-09-27: Reviewed exact caster gear-table slot and native intrinsic/partial properties. Partial piece bonuses need distinct compatible equipped companions and an observed stat, not inferred ownership. The Sorceress-only orb cannot activate a Warlock armor combination. Only matching fire/cold masteries and partial resistance modifiers support these reviewed damage modes. No full-set global bonus, melee leech for spells, socket filler or numerical price is inferred.
advisory_conditions: Intrinsic item bonuses are separate from partial bonuses. Partial bonuses require the observed stat and enough distinct compatible equipped set pieces; duplicate names do not count twice. The appraised piece counts once. No complete loadout or socket filler is inferred.

Armor casting speed needs two pieces; belt defense needs two and casting speed three. Orb Sorceress Skills needs two pieces, fire pierce three, and Cold Skill Damage all five. The class-exclusive orb cannot count as an equipped Warlock companion.

Mastery and resistance modifiers apply to the relevant wearer spells. Lightning Mastery and lightning pierce are not credited to these fire/cold builds. Helmet leech does not heal a caster from ordinary spell or summoned-minion damage. Damage Taken Goes to Mana is recovery from eligible damage, not damage reduction.
Whole-set bonuses are separate; do not infer them from owning a single piece or from an aggregate item stat. Respect casting breakpoints, requirements and survival needs.

reviews.rationale: 2026-09-27: Reviewed exact caster gear-table slot and native intrinsic/partial properties. Partial piece bonuses need distinct compatible equipped companions and an observed stat, not inferred ownership. The Sorceress-only orb cannot activate a Warlock armor combination. Only matching fire/cold masteries and partial resistance modifiers support these reviewed damage modes. No full-set global bonus, melee leech for spells, socket filler or numerical price is inferred.
advisory_conditions: Intrinsic item bonuses are separate from partial bonuses. Partial bonuses require the observed stat and enough distinct compatible equipped set pieces; duplicate names do not count twice. The appraised piece counts once. No complete loadout or socket filler is inferred.

Armor casting speed needs two pieces; belt defense needs two and casting speed three. Orb Sorceress Skills needs two pieces, fire pierce three, and Cold Skill Damage all five. The class-exclusive orb cannot count as an equipped Warlock companion.

Mastery and resistance modifiers apply to the relevant wearer spells. Lightning Mastery and lightning pierce are not credited to these fire/cold builds. Helmet leech does not heal a caster from ordinary spell or summoned-minion damage. Damage Taken Goes to Mana is recovery from eligible damage, not damage reduction.
Whole-set bonuses are separate; do not infer them from owning a single piece or from an aggregate item stat. Respect casting breakpoints, requirements and survival needs.
